title: Castle Hunt
theme: Castles in the parks, the films and the real world
intro: [excited] Raise the drawbridge and polish your crowns! Tonight is Castle Hunt: real-world castles, park castles and movie castles. [laughs] If you get the 1000s, you get a turret. Not really. But you could!

art.prompt: A grand panorama of many different fairy-tale castles on rolling hills, sea cliffs and snowy mountains, banners flying, golden sunrise light and drifting clouds Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Storybook Castles IRL
categories.intro: These are real castles in the real world that inspired the castles in Disney movies and parks. [gasps] Name the castle in the photo!

art.prompt: A vintage travel map of Europe with tiny illustrated castles, a compass rose, a magnifying glass and a pile of old postcards Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Built for King Ludwig II of Bavaria, this castle helped inspire Disneyland's Sleeping Beauty Castle. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Neuschwanstein Castle! Ludwig started building it in 1869. [chuckles] He moved in before it was finished. Relatable.

clues.clue: This French island abbey with a village spiraling up its sides helped inspire the kingdom of Corona in Tangled.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mont-Saint-Michel! [gasps] At high tide the island is surrounded by water. Very convenient for floating lanterns.

clues.clue: This ship-shaped Spanish fortress in Segovia is often said to have inspired Disney castle designs.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Alcázar of Segovia! It sits high on a rocky ridge where two rivers meet. Pointy blue-gray turrets for days.

clues.clue: This Loire Valley château is famous for a double-helix staircase and is often linked to Beast's castle in Beauty and the Beast.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the Château de Chambord! [laughs] Two staircases twist around each other, so people going up and down never meet. Perfect for avoiding a grumpy Beast.

clues.clue: Pixar artists visited this clifftop Scottish ruin while designing Clan DunBroch's castle in Brave. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Dunnottar Castle! It sits on a rocky headland near Stonehaven, with the North Sea crashing below. [whispers] Bring a windbreaker.

categories.title: Five Parks, Five Castles
categories.intro: Every Magic Kingdom-style park has a castle in the middle. [chuckles] Our Parks category: name the castle, or the park!

art.prompt: Five different fairy-tale castle towers side by side on five small floating islands, each in a different color, with fireworks bursting above Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: This 189-foot castle has been the icon of Walt Disney World's Magic Kingdom since 1971. Name it.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Cinderella Castle! Over 180 feet of turrets, and it's not made of stone at all. [laughs] Steel, concrete and fiberglass, baby!

clues.clue: Walt Disney's original castle opened with Disneyland in 1955 and is only about 77 feet tall. Name it.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Sleeping Beauty Castle! [chuckles] Small but mighty. Walt wanted a friendly castle, not a scary one.

clues.clue: Reimagined in 2020, this Hong Kong Disneyland castle celebrates 13 Disney princesses and queens. Name it.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is the Castle of Magical Dreams! Every tower and detail honors a different royal, from Snow White to Elsa.

clues.clue: Opened in 2016, this is the tallest Disney park castle at roughly 197 feet, and it honors all the princesses. Name it.
choices: Château de la Belle au Bois Dormant
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Enchanted Storybook Castle at Shanghai Disneyland! It even has a boat ride that sails right through it. [laughs] Most castles only have a moat.

clues.clue: This near-twin of Florida's castle opened in 1983, the first Disney castle outside the United States. Name the park.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tokyo Disneyland! [chuckles] Same name, Cinderella Castle, same look. But this one has its own tricks inside. True castle nerds know.

categories.title: Castle Keepsakes
categories.intro: Every movie castle keeps a treasure or two. [whispers] I'll show you the keepsake; you name the film!

art.prompt: A royal treasure room with a velvet cushion, a jeweled crown, an ornate hand mirror and a gilded chest under a stained-glass window Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A magic mirror on the wall of a queen's castle. Name the 1937 film.
clues.answer: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
accept: snow white and the seven dwarfs
choices: Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs! Mirror, mirror on the wall, who's the fairest of them all? [laughs] Not the Queen, apparently.

clues.clue: A tiger lounging in a sultan's palace garden beside a fountain. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [chuckles] Rajah is Jasmine's tiger, and he does not like suitors. Very good security system.

media.prompt: A large striped tiger lying beside a tiled fountain in a lush Arabian palace garden with onion domes and arches, moonlight and lanterns Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A lever in an emperor's throne room. Pull it and you fall into a trapdoor. Name the film.
clues.reveal: [laughs] The correct answer is The Emperor's New Groove! Pull the lever, Kronk! [chuckles] Wrong leverrrr!

media.prompt: A golden throne room with Inca-style stone carvings, a single large lever sticking out of the floor beside a llama-shaped carved throne, a dark trapdoor in the floor Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: A torn family tapestry in a Scottish castle hall, with the cut running between mother and daughter. Name the film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brave! [sighs] Merida slashed it in anger, and she has to mend the bond. Literally.

clues.clue: A cauldron glowing in the dungeon of an evil king's castle. Name this 1985 film.
clues.reveal: [whispers] The correct answer is The Black Cauldron! It was Disney's first animated film rated PG. [gasps] The Horned King gave everyone nightmares.

media.prompt: A huge black iron cauldron glowing with eerie green light in a dark stone dungeon, skull-shaped carvings in the walls, smoke curling upward Original illustration, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

categories.title: Who Holds Court?
categories.intro: Kings, queens, servants and sea kingdoms. [excited] Tell me who's who inside the movie castles!

art.prompt: A grand throne room with two empty golden thrones, red carpet, tall windows and royal banners, warm light pouring in Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: In Beauty and the Beast, this candelabra is the castle's charming maître d'.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Lumière! Be our guest! [laughs] He's very good with flames. Stay back, please.

clues.clue: In Frozen, Elsa builds her ice palace on this mountain.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is the North Mountain! [chuckles] Elsa let it go so hard, she built a palace in one song.

clues.clue: In Tangled, Rapunzel's royal parents rule this kingdom.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Corona! Every year on her birthday, they release lanterns hoping their lost princess will come home. [sighs] Get the tissues.

clues.clue: In Robin Hood, this thumb-sucking lion sits on England's throne while King Richard is away.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Prince John! [laughs] He cries for his mommy whenever someone mentions it. Peter Ustinov voiced him.

clues.clue: King Triton rules this undersea kingdom in The Little Mermaid.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is Atlantica! Not Atlantis. That's a different movie. [chuckles] Same water, different zip code.

categories.title: Castle Secrets
categories.intro: [whispers] Every castle has secrets. Our fan category is all the hidden stuff inside Disney's real castles.

art.prompt: A secret passage behind a castle tapestry, a glowing key on a velvet pillow, a spiral staircase and a hidden door slightly open Original illustration, 16:9, rich saturated colors, cinematic lighting, no people, no characters, no text, no logos.

clues.clue: Beneath the castle at Disneyland Paris, this giant fire-breathing creature sleeps in a hidden lair.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is a dragon! La Tanière du Dragon is a dark cave under the castle with a huge animatronic dragon. [laughs] He snores!

clues.clue: A luxury room hidden inside Magic Kingdom's castle, given to lucky guests, is called the Cinderella Castle what?
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is the Cinderella Castle Suite! It was originally planned for Walt's family. [whispers] You can't book it. You have to be chosen.

clues.clue: Upstairs in Cinderella Castle you can dine at Cinderella's Royal this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cinderella's Royal Table! [chuckles] Medieval dining with princesses and stained glass. Fancy!

clues.clue: Sleeping Beauty Castle's drawbridge has been lowered only twice: in 1955, and in this year when Fantasyland reopened.
clues.reveal: [excited] The correct answer is 1983! It came down for the New Fantasyland grand reopening. [chuckles] It's a working drawbridge, but it stays down.

clues.clue: The upper stones and windows of Disney castles get smaller as they rise, an illusion called this.
clues.reveal: [gasps] The correct answer is forced perspective! It makes the castle look much taller than it is. [laughs] Imagineers are sneaky.
